title: Fact Check: Gold Fringe On A U.S. Flag Does NOT Signal Maritime NOR Martial Law Is In Effect | Lead Stories
summary: Lead Stories fact check: gold fringe on a US flag is decorative, not a sign of martial or admiralty law, and courts call fringe-jurisdiction suits frivolous.

assertions.quote: the courts have deemed without merit and frivolous, lawsuits that contend that the gold fringe adorning the flag conferred Admiralty/Maritime jurisdiction
Gold fringe is a decorative option.

verdicts.note: Fringe carries no legal meaning and has been displayed routinely for decades.
No law requires or forbids fringe; per the Army Adjutant General and Attorney General it is 'without heraldic significance', and fringe does not turn a flag into a flag of war.
